sv.title: Rattsurfande busschauffören har fått sparken
sv.summary: Den busschaufför som i onsdags satt och scrollade på sin mobil medan han körde en fullsatt buss mellan Brandstorp och Habo har fått lämna sitt arbete – det meddelar JLT idag.

en.title: Bus driver caught surfing on phone has been fired
en.summary: The bus driver who on Wednesday sat scrolling on his phone while driving a packed bus between Brandstorp and Habo has lost his job, JLT reports today.
